paths.title: The LLM inference study path
paths.lead: Why an LLM answers as fast as it does, from the wait you see as a user down to measuring a real server on a rented GPU. Five days, taken in order. Each day is a plan over the courses below, with priming, pretests and checkpoints built in.

days.label: Day 1
days.title: Why a response takes as long as it does
days.blurb: Time to first token, output speed and length, and why agents take minutes. No ML background needed.

days.label: Day 1.5
days.title: Just enough about the model
days.blurb: What a model, a token and one forward pass are, and how a base model becomes an assistant.
days.tag: New to ML? Do this one

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Inside the GPU and the engine loop
days.blurb: What one decode step does to a GPU, how to measure it, and why a server batches.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: The math of serving
days.blurb: The step-time formula, why memory decides the batch, and how one chip becomes a fleet.

days.label: Day 4
days.title: Measure a real server
days.blurb: How to load-test, why the curve has a knee and what to watch, then the load-curve lab on a rented GPU.

later.label: Days 5–9
later.title: Engines, many GPUs and cost per token
later.blurb: A roadmap for now; each day will get its own plan.

paths.title: How a coding agent works
paths.lead: What a coding agent actually is, from the bare loop to measuring whether a change helped. Three days, taken in order, best after Day 1 of the inference path. Each day reads the Agents field guide's best sources with its questions and checkpoints, and ends with a small build.

days.label: Day 1
days.title: The loop and its tools
days.blurb: A model called in a loop, the tools it can use, and a 60-line agent you run yourself.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: What the model sees, and what it may do
days.blurb: Context engineering; skills, MCP, subagents and hooks; sandboxes and prompt injection.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Did it work? Evals and trajectories
days.blurb: Hidden tests, repeats and honest intervals, reading failed runs, and cost per solved task.

later.label: Go further
later.title: The full Agents projects
later.blurb: A real harness, a benchmark and an ablation table, each with a pass/fail test.

paths.title: Training agents with RL
paths.lead: From never having run reinforcement learning to training an LLM agent on a game nobody has trained on. Nine stages over Hugging Face's Training Agents series, grouped into four parts. Each stage has a primer, timestamped viewing, real scripts to run and a checkpoint.
paths.overviewText: See all nine stages, the GPU budget and the known gotchas →

days.label: Stages 0–1
days.title: RL from zero
days.blurb: Set up, then one hard day: returns, Q-learning, policy gradients, PPO and GRPO, worked by hand.

days.label: Stages 2–3
days.title: Agents and how to measure them
days.blurb: Agent traces, pass@k and error bars, then what changes when the policy is an agent.

days.label: Stages 4–6
days.title: Train it: SFT, distillation, GRPO
days.blurb: Fine-tune on agent traces, copy a teacher, then RL with rewards a program can check.

days.label: Stages 7–8
days.title: Environments and your game
days.blurb: The reward becomes a place you act in, then the capstone: teach an agent Tumblers.
